2607.17962.title: Topological Signatures of Context-Level Reliability in TabPFN
2607.17962.paper_summary: TabPFN is a transformer-based foundation model for tabular prediction that performs inference without task-specific training by conditioning on a support set and query inputs. Despite its strong empirical performance, its internal behavior on structurally difficult tabular geometries remains poorly understood. We study this behavior using zigzag persistent homology, treating TabPFN layer representations as evolving point clouds. We construct a controlled benchmark of synthetic tabular tasks with known true probabilities and varied intrinsic topology, including warped circles, tori, spheres, Hopf links, trefoil knots, and Swiss rolls. Across these tasks, we find that the topology of TabPFN's internal representation geometry is strongly associated with dataset-level reliability; for example, the zeroth homology group $H_0$ fragmentation count correlates positively with mean absolute residual across controlled tasks, and this association strengthens in a high-resolution warped circle case study at large sample size. Harder geometries induce a dual topological signature: increased $H_1$ loop activity and increased $H_0$ fragmentation, while the $H_1$ persistence becomes shorter-lived. These descriptors correlate with Bayes error, mean absolute residuals, and overconfidence. Our results suggest that zigzag persistence diagnoses the reliability of the inferred in-context task geometry and provides a context-level view of when TabPFN operates in topologically stressed regimes.
2607.17962.paper_summary_zh: TabPFN 是一種基於Transformer的基礎模型，用於表格預測，通過對支持集和查詢輸入進行條件處理來執行推斷，而無需特定任務的訓練。儘管其在實證表現上強勁，但其在結構上困難的表格幾何體內部行為仍然不甚了解。我們使用鋸齒形持續同調研究這一行為，將 TabPFN 層表示視為不斷演變的點雲。我們構建了一個受控的基準，包含已知真實概率和多樣內在拓撲的合成表格任務，包括扭曲的圓形、環面、球體、霍普鏈、三葉結和瑞士捲。 在這些任務中，我們發現 TabPFN 的內部表示幾何的拓撲與數據集層級的可靠性有著強烈的關聯；例如，零次同調群 $H_0$ 的碎片計數與受控任務中的平均絕對殘差正相關，並且在大型樣本量的高分辨率扭曲圓形案例研究中，這一關聯加強。更困難的幾何形狀會引發雙重拓撲特徵：增加的 $H_1$ 環活動性和增加的 $H_0$ 碎片化，而 $H_1$ 的持續時間變得更短。這些描述符與貝葉斯誤差、平均絕對殘差和過度自信相關。我們的結果表明，鋸齒形持續性診斷了推斷的上下文任務幾何的可靠性，並提供了 TabPFN 在拓撲受壓狀態下運行時的上下文層級視圖。
2607.17962.author: James Hu et.al.
